subject.title: refactor(channels): move inbound turn execution into core

question: Should the public Plugin SDK expose the new resolver-only `configOverride` parameter, or should the Microsoft Teams timezone case be solved through an existing internal/core-owned seam?
rationale: The branch changes exported dispatch contracts and regenerates the Plugin SDK API baseline. Tests can show forwarding behavior but cannot determine the intended long-term external SDK contract.

options.title: Accept the narrow SDK addition
options.body: Approve `configOverride` as a documented resolver-only Plugin SDK contract and retain focused forwarding and compatibility tests.

options.title: Keep the override internal
options.body: Rework the Teams-specific timezone override behind a core-owned or channel-owned internal seam so the public dispatch API remains unchanged.

recommendation.title: Keep the override internal
recommendation.body: Rework the Teams-specific timezone override behind a core-owned or channel-owned internal seam so the public dispatch API remains unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete introduced the preceding core ownership design and is best positioned to explain whether this public contract is intentional or merely an internal migration aid.
